visualCharacteristics.purpose: Inline newsletter sign-up form (email, first name, country, local newsletter opt-in, required consent) posted to a subscription service, with a success message after sign-up
visualCharacteristics.layout: rounded light green tint panel; stacked bold labels above full-width white inputs, grey country select, two small checkbox lines, navy pill submit button below

contentPattern.structure: single cell: optional intro (heading/paragraphs); bulleted list of fields in fixed order (Email label > nested placeholder, invalid-email message; First name label > nested placeholder; Country label > nested prompt then one country per item; local newsletter checkbox text; consent checkbox text, may contain a link); paragraph link = submit button (text = label, href = endpoint); paragraph = required-field message; paragraph = success message; optional paragraph link shown after sign-up
contentPattern.sourceDescription: Join the community page newsletter form: Email Address *, First Name *, Country * select with ~230 countries, local newsletter checkbox, privacy consent checkbox with link, navy "Subscribe now" button; success panel "Thanks for subscribing!" with a link back to the homepage

usage: Join the community page, below the "Subscribe to our monthly newsletter" heading and intro text.
reuseGuidance: Same fields, form field names (EMAIL, FNAME, COUNTRY, MERGE9, first-consent) and authoring as the footer newsletter dialog; all labels, countries and messages are authored, so the block can be localised per market. Use the footer dialog (links to #newsletter) for a pop-up sign-up and this block for an inline one.
